subject: Matemática
description_pt: Identificar características do sistema de numeração decimal, utilizando a composição e a decomposição de número natural de até quatro ordens.

components.description_pt: Identificar o papel do valor posicional no sistema de numeração decimal para números de até quatro dígitos
components.description_en: Identify the role of positional value in the decimal number system for numbers up to four digits
components.cc_component_description: Compare two two-digit numbers by comparing the digits in each place value

components.description_pt: Compor números naturais de até quatro ordens usando seus componentes posicionais
components.description_en: Compose whole numbers of up to four place values using their positional components
components.cc_component_description: Find whole number quotients of whole numbers with four-digit dividends and two-digit divisors using strategies based on place value, the properties of operations, and/or the relationship between multiplication and division

components.description_pt: Descrever características do sistema de numeração decimal usando composição e decomposição de números
components.description_en: Describe characteristics of the decimal number system using composition and decomposition of numbers
components.cc_component_description: Explain patterns in the placement of the decimal point when multiplying a decimal by a power of 10

cc_matches.description: Compare two two-digit numbers based on meanings of the tens and ones digits, recording the results of comparisons with the symbols >, =, and <.

Find whole-number quotients of whole numbers with up to four-digit dividends and two-digit divisors, using strategies based on place value, the properties of operations, and/or the relationship between multiplication and division. Illustrate and explain the calculation by using equations, rectangular arrays, and/or area models.

Explain patterns in the number of zeros of the product when multiplying a number by powers of 10, and explain patterns in the placement of the decimal point when a decimal is multiplied or divided by a power of 10. Use whole-number exponents to denote powers of 10.

prerequisites.description_pt: Registrar com números a quantidade de crianças (meninas e meninos, presentes e ausentes) e a quantidade de objetos da mesma natureza (bonecas, bolas, livros etc.).
